speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Is your subject popular in your country?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Oh, it's very popular in China. Everybody knows about computer science, and a lot of people want to study it. Some people — like me — switched majors into it, and there are many others who made the same choice. Because everybody believes computer science means a high-paying job, and everybody loves money, actually. So yes, it's very popular.
